groups.title: Live fleet cancellation preserves drafts and releases private reservations
Live fleet formation and disband conserve private forces
Live fleet reorganization recovers one private split and conserves forces
Live zero science after orbital loss preserves private research
Open a contextual arrival report and recover its recorded surface
Live fleet contacts preserve acquired and last-seen private facts across reload

method: Individually viewed all58 new distinct changed-region originals in29 sequential two-image sheets. Crops include every changed RGBA pixel plus32px context; all pixels outside bounds verified identical to inherited references. Full original composition remains retained. Sheet display slightly downscaled by viewer; regression content/layout approval, not native-pixel design certification. Exact first-failure hashes retain earlier inspection.
findings: Resource rail remains above full fleet hero; inherited compact campaign-name truncation persists.
Formation/cancel/disband, split1/8 and retained3/10, merge4/18, accepted ticks, reservation privacy, disabled duplicates and primary footer actions remain readable.
Release Form fleet and route Send fleet focus outlines contained. Accepted-order views retain intentional bounded-scroll offsets with neighboring inactive navigation partly offscreen.
Route editor remains an intentional overlay over chart; accepted route view reveals complete route. This is not a claim that every star remains exposed during editing, or full concept fidelity.
Owner/private-peer and reload/acknowledgement states individually reviewed, rather than inferred from first failures.
scope: Exact changed-hash regression approval only; no full design/normal motion/privacy-rule/release acceptance.
